title: Disjunctive normal form for sorting three bits
statement: For inputs of three signs, let the sorting function take the value $-1$ exactly when the corresponding bits are monotone (nondecreasing or nonincreasing), and $1$ otherwise. The disjunctive normal form whose terms specify those monotone bit patterns computes this function.
caveat: The supplied declaration refers to a disjunctive normal form whose defining construction is absent from the supplied upstream definitions; the description of its terms is inferred from the theorem name.
